name: Project ASTER
description: Autonomous asteroid-mining robot. Phase 1 develops a low-gravity locomotion system and a ground demonstrator (hopping concept candidates: spring hopper, internal flywheel hopper) tested in a reduced-gravity analogue rig with embedded control software. All data in this demonstration are synthetic.
objectives: Characterise hopping locomotion in a low-gravity analogue
Select a locomotion concept for preliminary design
_notes: One profile serves select_frameworks.py (reads name/description/flags) and tailor_process.py (reads top-level risk/safety/novelty keys). Adapted from .claude/skills/select-frameworks/assets/examples/profile-aster.json. Unknowns: team size is a planning assumption; jurisdiction for any future flight phase not assessed.
